title: ReadinessReport
description: The result of one readiness scan (master plan 9.5, ADR 0037): a requirements inventory of the project AlixAI is being added to, with the evidence-bound findings behind it. It is ADVISORY: it never certifies, never signs, never activates and never edits a package, and a complete report is not an audit pass; the integration audit (master plan 4.5) still decides activation. It carries no score, grant, permission, approval or pass/fail verdict, and no field may be read as one. With no model the deterministic leg runs alone and the report says so; a model used is labelled with its qualification state. Reports are stored with a hash of their inputs so a later scan can say what changed.

schema_version.description: The contract generation of this document.

report_id.description: The ID minted for this report.

advisory.description: Always true: the report is advice to the operator, not a certification and not an audit result.

scanned_root.description: The directory the operator named, as the operator wrote it.

inputs_sha256.description: A hash over the scanned files (their relative paths and hashes), the catalog, the scan options and the version of the readiness rules, so an unchanged project gives the same value.

catalog_version.description: The version of the requirement catalog the scan used.

catalog_sha256.description: The hash of the requirement catalog the scan used.

evaluator_version.description: The version of the readiness rules that evaluated the requirements (the scan's detectors, the verifier and the checklist evaluator). It is part of inputs_sha256, so a report made by older rules is not current even when the files are unchanged. Absent in a report from a release that did not record it, which counts as version 1.

previous_report_id.description: The report this one follows, when the operator re-scanned the same directory. Absent on a first scan.

mode.description: deterministic_only: no model ran and the report says so. deterministic_and_model: a model proposed findings that the verifier then checked.

model.description: The model that proposed findings. Present exactly when the mode is deterministic_and_model.

model_leg.description: What happened to the optional model leg (master plan 9.5, ADR 0037): whether a model ran, why it did not, and what its output was worth. Absent in a report built without the assist leg. A model that did not run leaves the report deterministic_only and this says why; a model that ran can only have added findings, and the counts show how many of its proposals were dropped and how many tried to change a status a rule decided.

scan.description: What the scan covered and what it left out.

checklist.description: One entry per catalog requirement, in catalog order: the status of each and the findings behind it.

summary.description: How many checklist entries are in each status.

findings.description: Every finding of the scan, deterministic and model.

model_id.description: The model that read the excerpts.

runtime.description: local: a model on the operator-controlled machine, the default. external: a model reached through the data-egress guard, off by default.

qualification.description: unqualified: the model is not certified for any task (the Lite controller is uncertified) and its output is labelled unqualified, advisory. qualified: the model passed the qualification the registry records for this use.

label.description: The label shown beside the model wherever its findings appear. The builder and the store keep it in step with the qualification and nothing else: 'unqualified, advisory' unless the registry shows a qualified status for this use, and even then the findings are advice the verifier has checked. Absent in a report built without the assist leg.

modelLeg.description: The state of the model leg. status says whether a model ran: not_configured (none is set up), unavailable (the model could not be reached or timed out), failed (it answered in a way that could not be used), refused (policy, the data-egress guard or the external-mode switch said no, and nothing was sent) or ran. Anything but ran leaves the report deterministic_only, and any model output of a leg that did not run is discarded whole.

prompt_template_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the fixed prompt template and the closed output schema the model was given. Absent when no prompt was built. It lets a later scan tell that the instructions to the model changed.

calls.description: How many times the model was called. Zero when it was not.

proposals_received.description: How many proposals the model made across all calls, one per requirement it named.

dropped_proposals.description: How many proposals did not become findings at all: malformed, for an unknown or decided requirement, citing text that looks like an instruction, over the proposal cap or refused by the verifier. A proposal whose evidence did not confirm is not dropped; it is listed as a model_unverified finding.

attempted_overrides.description: How many of the dropped proposals tried to do more than add a finding: change or restate a status a rule decided, claim any status but found or partial, carry a field outside the closed schema such as a removal, or rest on a project line that reads as an instruction. They are dropped and counted, never applied.

budget_exhausted.description: True when the token or call budget of the scan stopped the leg before every excerpt was read, so absence of a model finding is not evidence of absence.

scanStats.description: Counts for one scan. A truncated scan hit a size or file-count cap, so absence of a finding in it is not evidence of absence.

files_skipped.description: Files not read: dependency and VCS directories, binaries, files over the size cap and files past the file-count cap.

secret_files_recorded.description: Secret-looking files recorded as present and never read.

values_redacted.description: Secret-looking values redacted before anything reached the report, the model or a log.

truncated.description: True when a size or file-count cap stopped the scan early.

checklistItem.description: The status of one requirement and the findings it rests on.

check_id.description: The audit check the requirement feeds.

level.description: Whether the requirement is mandatory or recommended.

status.description: The status of the requirement after the findings are combined. Never found on the strength of a model_unverified finding.

finding_ids.description: The findings behind the status. Empty when nothing was found.
